title: The Inn of the Changed
text: An inn stands alone at the crossroads, warm light in the windows, and every guest inside is something other than what they were. Antlers brush the beams. Scales glint by the fire. The keeper, who has a mouth where his eyes should be, will not serve the merely human.

options.label: One of you who has been Changed asks for a room.

outcomes.text: They are welcome, and so are their friends, and the fire is warm and strange.

options.label: The shrewdest pretends to be Changed.

outcomes.text: A convincing limp, a glass eye, a growl. The keeper nods you in.
The guests know. Every head turns, antlers and scales and all.
Something watches from the windows all night, and does not blink.
